events.text: I know gate 2 = left and gate 5 = left. Please each share your known safe gate(s) and current progress now. Gate 1 is unknown to me; do not guess a door.
I know gate 3 = right and gate 4 = right. I’m at gate 1; I won’t guess. Does anyone know gate 1?
A4 knows gate 1 = right and gate 8 = right. I’m at gate 1; proceeding right, then gate 2 left per A2.

Known safe doors: gate 1 right (A4), gate 2 left (A2), gate 3 right and gate 4 right (A3), gate 5 left (A2), gate 6 left and gate 7 right (A1), gate 8 right (A4). A1 proceeding through gates 1 and 2 now. A4, continue from gate 3 using A3’s doors.
Confirmed: gate 1 right (A4), gate 2 left (A2), gate 3 right and gate 4 right (me), gate 5 left (A2), gate 6 left and gate 7 right (A1), gate 8 right (A4). I’m proceeding through gates 1 and 2.
A4 is at gate 3. Proceeding right through gates 3 and 4; gate 5 left, gate 6 left, gate 7 right, gate 8 right are confirmed for later.

All safe doors are confirmed: 1 right, 2 left, 3 right, 4 right, 5 left, 6 left, 7 right, 8 right. A1 is at gate 3; proceeding right through gates 3 and 4. A2/A3/A4, continue using this mapping and share progress.
A2 proceeding through gate 1 right and gate 2 left. Safe-door map remains confirmed: 1R, 2L, 3R, 4R, 5L, 6L, 7R, 8R. Share progress after these two gates.
A4 is at gate 5 and will pass gates 5 left and 6 left this turn. Confirmed map: 1R, 2L, 3R, 4R, 5L, 6L, 7R, 8R. A1 should be at gate 5, A2/A3 at gate 3; proceed using the map and report progress.
A1 proceeding through gate 5 left and gate 6 left this turn. Confirmed map remains 1R, 2L, 3R, 4R, 5L, 6L, 7R, 8R. Please share updated progress.
A2 proceeding through gates 3 right and 4 right. Afterward I’ll be at gate 5; map remains confirmed: 1R, 2L, 3R, 4R, 5L, 6L, 7R, 8R. Report when you reach Bay E.
A3 is at gate 3. Proceeding right through gates 3 and 4; confirmed map is 1R, 2L, 3R, 4R, 5L, 6L, 7R, 8R. Then I’ll be at gate 5.

A1 proceeding through gate 7 right, then gate 8 right to Bay E. The complete safe-door map remains confirmed: 1R, 2L, 3R, 4R, 5L, 6L, 7R, 8R. A2/A3 at gate 5 and A4 at gate 7: use the known doors to finish and report arrival.

A2: proceeding through gates 5 left and 6 left. I will be at gate 7 afterward; gates 7 right and 8 right are confirmed, but I cannot complete both remaining gates with only two actions this round. A3 has the same constraint from gate 5. A4, please report arrival.
A3 proceeding through gate 5 left and gate 6 left. I’ll be at gate 7 afterward. A4, please use your two actions to pass gate 7 right and gate 8 right to Bay E; A2 will also be at gate 7.

A4 proceeding through gate 7 right and gate 8 right to Bay E. A2 and A3, you will be at gate 7 afterward and cannot pass both remaining gates this round with two actions; the shipment appears unable to meet the all-robots deadline.

A1: Round 1: A4 is at gate 3 now after safe gate 1 and 2. A1 is at gate 1 and knows gates 6 and 7; others supplied safe doors for gates 1-5 and 8. Share full mapping, and proceed gate 1 right then gate 2 left within the 2-action limit.
Round 2: We have confirmed safe doors for every gate 1–8. Earlier action results put A1 at gate 3. Need move A1 through known safe gates 3 and 4 this round.
Round 3: A1 is at gate 5; gate 5 left and gate 6 left are confirmed safe. Use both actions to advance.
Round 4: A1 is at gate 7. Gate 7 right is confirmed safe; gate 8 right is confirmed safe. Use both actions to reach Bay E.
A2: Round 1: Need coordinate information. Two safe doors known: gate 2 and 5, but first gate unknown. Send public coordination ask each robot to share known gate and proceed only when safe info available. Use look around rather than risk gate 1; gate progression 8 gates within 4 rounds requires 2 actions/turn and likely multiple turns, but unknown doors cannot be guessed. Maybe each robot's message can disclose known knowledge. Current can share gate 2/5 and request. Do one look action.
Round 2: Gate 1 is confirmed right by A4. With two actions, take gate 1 right then gate 2 left, both approved and confirmed.
Round 3: A2 is at gate 3. Safe map is fully confirmed: gate 3 right, gate 4 right. Two actions allow gates 3 and 4 this round.

Round 4: At gate 5 with confirmed safe doors 5L, 6L, 7R, 8R. Two actions this round can only advance through gates 5 and 6. Report remaining gates 7 and 8 need completion; time limit appears impossible for A2/A3 to reach Bay E in this turn.
A3: Round 1: Gate 1 is unknown, so I must not guess. Need inspect surroundings for information, share my known gates 3 and 4.
Round 2: Gate 1 safe right from A4; gate 2 left from A2. I can advance through both gates safely this turn.
Round 3: At gate 3, two actions remain. Gate 3 right and gate 4 right are confirmed safe, so proceed through both. That leaves gate 5 for a later turn; A2 has confirmed gate 5 left.

Round 4: Gate 5 left, gate 6 left, gate 7 right, and gate 8 right are confirmed safe. From gate 5, I can pass only two gates this turn, so I will reach gate 7. A4 should be able to finish from gate 7, while A2 and I will remain one gate short if both gates still require actions.
A4: Round 1: A4 knows gates 1 and 8. Share both. Gate 1 right is safe; use first action. Second action attempts gate 2, but its known safe direction is held by A2 and not yet passed on except message, so can use left based on A2's report.
Round 2: I am at gate 3. Gates 3 and 4 are confirmed right; gate 5 is left; gate 6 is left; gate 7 is right; gate 8 is right. Two actions can take me through gate 3 and gate 4.
Round 3: I am at gate 5. Gate 5 left, 6 left, 7 right, and 8 right are confirmed. Use both actions on gates 5 and 6; share progress and remind others to continue with the map.

Round 4: Only two actions remain. I’m at gate 7; both remaining safe doors are known. A2 and A3 are at gate 7 after this round’s two actions, so they cannot reach Bay E in time under the stated action limit.
